name: Space Force waist-to-height ratio

source.document: SPFMAN 36-2905, Human Performance and Readiness, chapter 9 (Body Composition Assessment)

ifOver: A body fat measurement follows (a lab assessment, or a 2-3 site tape measurement if none is available). The maximum is 26% for men and 36% for women; over that, the member does not meet the standard.
notes: The ratio is cut off (not rounded) after two decimals, so 0.5486 counts as 0.54. A ratio of 0.55 or more exceeds the standard.
The Space Force body composition standard is the same for every age and sex.
